title: Defending the context window in Nanocoder 1.30
focus: A behind-the-scenes tour of the tail-weighted bash truncation, oversized-result bounding that preserves the actionable tail, the string_replace and diff_edit edits now bounded around the changed region, git_diff capped at a 20-entry diffstat, list_directory dropping sizes by default, write_file stopping from echoing the file back, read_file returning a preview before demanding a ranged read, and dropping toLocaleString separators in model-facing strings.
